Name: Stacy
Dialog: I'm coming as fast as I can, Candace! I'm at your house. Now, what kind of emergency are we dealing with? A parent emergency? A Phineas and Ferb emergency? Oh my--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (has an unusual hairstyle) Ahhhh-ha-ha! AHHHH!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: A hair emergency

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I did it to myself.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Why?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy's mom is hosting a benefit for endangered animals this afternoon, and I wanted a new look!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: So you want your hair to look like an endangered species?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, there are all these hairdo How-To videos online. They make it look so easy.

Name: Lady in Video
Dialog: Just brush it up, toss your head back, and voila! It's simplicious.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not simplicious! It's hard-plicious!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, take it easy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look at me! (Lies on laptop keyboard) A tragic victim of Internet hair stylists!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sorry, I don't think there's anything I can do, but there are a couple of guys who could...

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no way!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, are these chopsticks?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, all right. PHINEAS AND FERRRB?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you think? We've been working on our spit takes all morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, you're hilarious. Listen, I need you two to get me out of this situation.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Why? Your hair looks simplicious!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Have you tried tossing your head back?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, I don't have time to explain. Just get me back to the way I was.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, but I think you're making a mistake.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry? (Candace glares at her) What, I'm like the only person who's never said it.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good afternoon, Agent P. For the past few days, our motion sensors have detected Dr. Doofenshmirtz rummaging around in his basement. So, last night we had Carl staked out down there behind his water heater.

Name: Carl
Dialog: It was horrible down there!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I saw a rat give birth... to a snail!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just tell him about Doofenshmirtz.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz kept coming down and grabbing pieces of his old Inators from cardboard boxes. Oh no, brown recluse spider's favor dwelling in cardboard! (Major Monogram touches him in the ear; He shrieks) Get it off! Get it off!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Get out there and find out what Doof is up to. (At Carl) Seriously Carl? What a baby.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think it laid eggs in my ear!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So by combining ultra-violet and infrared waves together with follicle stimulation properties, not only does it style your hair, but it stimulates and accelerates new hair growth! So that should take care of that little shaved area. (at Stacy) What's that all about?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Don't get me started.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Candace) All you have to do is sit there for thirty minutes on setting five and you're good to go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, tick-tock.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Start her up Ferb. (at Candace) Remember, thirty minutes on setting five.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks guys!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What was that?Candace

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I don't know Candace, maybe you shouldn't mess with-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah, it'll be fine.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (nervously) Ok.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Besides Stacy, they wouldn't put a twenty on it if it weren't meant to be used, right?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well...I guess so.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my ten seconds are up! (lifts the top part of the machine from her head) Well, how does it look?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (gasps) I can't believe it! It's perfect!Candace

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, now help me find something cute to wear.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus I don't like your tone. (plays dramatic chords on the organ) Behold...I give you...The very VERY BAD-INATOR!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's made up of only the most evil parts of my old Inators, cobbled together without any rhyme or reason. My plan is to load it on my floating platform, take it high above the Tri-State Area and, you know, turn it on and see what it does. (turns towards Perry) I have no idea but I-I'm sure it's gonna be bad. Hence, Very Bad-inator. (pretends to shiver) Ooh, I got a chill!

Name: (The scene changes to the Natural History Museum where Jeremy's parents are hosting the benefit for endangered animals.)Candace
Dialog: (walking into the museum) Wow, nice turnout.Jeremy

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (on the flying platform) Be careful Perry the Platypus, you're awfully close to the edge. Oh! Let me help you back. (laughs as Perry is sent from one side of the platform to the other) Oh. Oh I can't quite- Whoops! I'm just messing with ya.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace! Candace? Now where'd she go?Candace

Name: (Doofenshmirtz is still rummaging through the picnic basket while Perry struggles to free himself from his trap)Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh yes. Peanut butter and honey sandwiches. The trick is the honey, and you get to use one of these weird honey-spoony things. It's- (crashes are heard) Perry the Platypus, did you just say gungalingdung? (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz in the face, causing honey to pour all over Doofenshmirtz) Aww, great! Now I'm all sticky. (he gets up while Perry goes to the controls) Oh, now this was my last clean lab coat too. Ugh, it's on now!  (Perry takes the controls with a mischievous smirk on his face as he rocks the platform back and forth.) Hey! Hey, hey! What are you doing? Oh, oh I get. Payback. Very funny, Perry the Platypus. Very mature.

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: (reading the instruction manual for the tranquilizer gun) Thank you for purchasing the Hanson 3000 Family Friendly Tranquidart Air-contrast delivery system. There are many like it but this one is yours.Candace

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: As soon as I get this honey off of me, I- (Candace's hair hits Doofenshmirtz, sending him screaming off of the platform and onto the pole where Candace once was.) Is this hair? (Perry is still on the platform and manages to disable the Very Bad-inator. He escapes on his glider.) Oh, no! Now I'll never know what the Bad-inator does! Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: The red plunger will act as a non-return valve and retain the air within the dart. Fear not, helpless primate! Bright banquets of the Elysian vale will soon melt every care away, or my name isn't Hawk-eye Johnson! (aims; tranquilizer gun cocks; shoots)Doofenshmirtz
